column5: Down at the coast, the sea would already be wild.
Beach umbrellas would rip loose and cartwheel across the sand.
The beach would be empty within minutes.
Sand would blast across the boulevard, hard enough to sting your skin.
Slowly, the sky would turn a dusty brown.
The palm trees would bend almost flat.
Their leaves would tear away, one by one.
At one hundred and eighty, the street lamps would start to bend.
Balconies would rip away from the hotels.
Chimneys would topple from the rooftops.
The strength of a category five hurricane.
Even the strongest hurricanes only keep this up for a few hours.
Any normal storm would have passed by now.
This one would only be getting started.
